text:
laura-fin: Heads-up — KitePay just sent their retainer invoice for March (INV-2026-03) but there's no PO on the PDF or in the email. Concur rejects it. Vendor claims PO is `PO-RET-42` but that doesn't match our system.

sam-ops: @laura-fin can you paste the invoice header / vendor email? I'll look up the vendor record.

laura-fin: pasted snippet:
```
Vendor: KitePay LLC
Invoice: INV-2026-03
Amount: $25,000.00
PO: (blank)
Email from vendor: billing@kitepay.com - "PO-RET-42"
```
Original approver was Alex M. (left 2/2026) and delegation wasn't set, so the approval flow is stalled. Need someone to approve or a retro PO.

priya-purchasing: Ack. Procurement wasn't looped on the retainer conversion. We can raise a retro PO but we need an approver on record. Which cost center / owner should it live under for Eng Infra?

jorge-acct: I can temporarily approve to avoid month-end hold — I'll add an approval note: "temp approval by Jorge for KitePay retainer, pending procurement PO creation." Is that acceptable? :thumbsup: 

laura-fin: That would unblock us. Please approve in Concur and add the note. @priya-purchasing, can you create retro PO `PO-RET-042` (or closest available) and link it to INV-2026-03 in NetSuite? Need audit trail.

priya-purchasing: On it. Creating PO and linking now, should be done within ~2 hours. I'll also file a delegation update ticket so future invoices routed to Alex get redirected. :memo:

invoice-bot: Invoice INV-2026-03 status updated: queued for approval by jorge-acct. Action required.

sam-ops: Thanks all — tagging @finance-leads and @procurement for visibility. Will follow up if vendor pushes for expedited payment. :eyes:
